inbox_more_waiting: ${count} more waiting; claim(conversation="${conversation_id}") reads them all.
awareness_temporary: ${label}: ${remaining} allocated work periods remain after current work.
awareness_omitted_reports: ${omitted} additional relevant reports omitted from this view.
workspace_unavailable: Workspace is not available in this work period.
workspace_outside_line: Workspace readable only by its reporting line; ask that role to put what you need in shared/.
hire_followup: They receive your mandate automatically. No kickoff message is needed; send follow-up mail for new information or a change.
mail_not_queued: Message ${message_id} was queued for no one.
mail_find_recipient: Use find_roles to find the intended recipient.
claim_reading: Messages claimed. This records reading, not completion of their work.
claim_remaining: ${count} more waiting in ${conversation_id}; claim it again to read them.
dismissed: Set aside ${count} messages without reading them.
cleared: Cleared ${count} messages that were waiting at your last peek: ${conversations}.
disposition_needs_peek: Nothing to ${operation}: peek first. Setting mail aside covers only what your last peek could show, so nothing is set aside unseen.
nothing_waiting: Nothing to ${operation}: no mail was waiting there.
summary_attached: A derived summary of the earlier conversation travels with it.
summary_unavailable: The introduction was sent without a summary: the summary was unavailable (${reason}). Its recipients can ask for context on the earlier conversation.
summary_label: Derived summary of the earlier conversation, attached by Operations, not the author's words:
access_pending: The owner has been asked. The answer arrives as mail: take up other work or finish normally to pause with working memory intact; set a reminder when it serves a real future check, and hand off only when you need a fresh start or Operations requires it.
mandate_updated: Updated ${address} (${employee_id}) to mandate revision ${revision}. They receive it next work period; current work is not interrupted. Send mail if the change needs attention.
retired: Retired ${person}. Files and records are retained.
temporary_remaining: ${employee_id}: ${remaining_periods} allocated work periods remain. Identity, files and working memory are preserved.
document_continues: This document continues on the next page.
tree_depth: ${omitted} roles beyond this depth; browse a deeper tree.
retry_dependency: Work still waits for Operations to restore the shared service.
